description: Interactive terminal sessions for programs that need ongoing input (REPLs, TUIs, prompts), under the same sandbox as the shell tool. Not for searching, reading files or one-shot commands: use Codebase Admin shell, file_search and file_read.
skill_summary: Drive a session-scoped PTY with open, read, send, wait and close. Read before every send; use Codebase Admin shell for one-shot commands.
migration_note: Rust worker terminals: each command runs on a pseudo-terminal under the workspace sandbox. Execution still requires applicable installation, account-tier, agent, membership and session grants.
owner_tier_note: Hard-coded: Administrator abilities work only for an administrator owner and an administrator caller, whatever this list says.
